title: Rumour at the hedge
body: A farmer swears the cemetery made a shovelling sound after midnight. The road is still quiet, but people are listening.

choices.label: Hide the workers
choices.description: Send everyone to cover for a moment.

choices.label: Pause digging
choices.description: Lose a little momentum while the rumour cools.

title: Questions by the road
body: A villager points at the fresh earth and asks why the ground keeps moving. Your answer will set the tone for the next few minutes.

choices.label: Spend mana on a ward
choices.description: A soft green light makes the cemetery look peaceful.

choices.label: Hide and wait
choices.description: Keep the operation still until the question passes.

title: The boundary is watched
body: A priest and a local official have reached the road boundary. They have not entered, but every noisy job now matters.

choices.label: Accept the setback
choices.description: Give up materials and keep the peace.

choices.label: Raise the lantern ward
choices.description: Spend mana to make the cemetery feel forgotten.
